---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea
title: '[feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Problem to solve**
What can't you do today? Include the TypeScript schema shape and the Dart API you wish existed.

**Proposed solution**
How you think it should work, including wire implications (backward compatibility with running servers).

**Alternatives considered**
Workarounds you've tried, or prior art from other ecosystems.

**Checklist**
- [ ] Doesn't break the zero-cast guarantee
- [ ] Doesn't introduce internal planning jargon
- [ ] Includes tests (failing test written first)
